title: Allocation
description: What a funding source has allocated to one project, as the budget's holder decides it: an amount, whether it is approved, still requested or refused, and when it was decided. A record of its own, after the project in the order of work, because the holder decides it and not the project: the project's cost lines on that source take their status from it and may not come to more (TAXONOMY.md D69). Not a cost line, which says what the project will spend the money on.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the amount.

status.description: Whether the allocation is approved, requested and not yet decided, or refused.

note.description: Anything about the decision the fields above cannot hold, such as a condition on the money.
